logFile.title: Homebridge Log File
logFile.description: Absolute path to the Homebridge log file. If omitted, the plugin uses homebridge.log in the Homebridge storage directory.

errorThreshold.title: Anomaly Threshold
errorThreshold.description: Number of counted anomalies inside the analysis window required to trigger the main sensor.

errorSensorType.title: Main Sensor Type (Errors)

oneOf.title: Leak sensor (may sound during Do Not Disturb)

errorSensorType.description: A type change replaces the accessory after restart. Select Leak before the first restart after upgrading to keep the previous leak sensor and its HomeKit automations.

analysisWindowSeconds.title: Analysis Window
analysisWindowSeconds.description: Rolling time window, in seconds, used to count anomalies.

resetAfterSeconds.title: Automatic Reset Delay
resetAfterSeconds.description: Number of seconds without a new counted anomaly before the corresponding sensor returns to normal.

monitorWarnings.title: Monitor WARN Lines
monitorWarnings.description: In single-sensor mode, include WARN and WARNING in the global anomaly threshold. Warnings remain available in local diagnostics in either mode.

scanIntervalSeconds.title: Scan Interval
scanIntervalSeconds.description: How often the plugin reads new lines appended to the log file.

groupRepeatedErrors.title: Group Repeated Errors
groupRepeatedErrors.description: Group identical trimmed error messages from the same identified source. Distinct IDs and numbers remain distinct.

repeatWindowSeconds.title: Repeated Error Window
repeatWindowSeconds.description: Rolling window in seconds for repeated errors.

pluginErrorThreshold.title: Critical Errors Per Plugin
pluginErrorThreshold.description: Trigger the error/global alert when one identified source reaches this many errors in the analysis window or identical errors in the repeated error window.

reconnectIntervalSeconds.title: Log Reconnection Interval
reconnectIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between retries while the log file is unavailable.

historyLimit.title: History Record Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of locally stored anomaly records (a repeated group occupies one record while its first occurrence remains in the window).

separateWarningSensor.title: Separate Warning Sensor
separateWarningSensor.description: Expose an additional sensor for warnings. The main sensor then counts errors only. Warning monitoring is enabled for the warning sensor independently of monitorWarnings.

warningSensorType.title: Separate Warning Sensor Type

oneOf.title: Leak sensor (may sound during Do Not Disturb)

warningSensorType.description: Applies only when Separate Warning Sensor is enabled. A type change replaces the accessory after restart. Select Leak before the first restart after upgrading to keep the previous warning leak sensor and its HomeKit automations.

warningThreshold.title: Warning Sensor Threshold
warningThreshold.description: Warnings in the analysis window required to activate the optional separate warning sensor.
